description: This file handles the processing of 'Get' requests within a USP (User Services Platform) agent. It includes functions for parsing get requests, resolving device paths, forming responses, and managing internal data structures related to parameter retrieval and error handling.

classes.name: get_expr_info_t
classes.description: Structure storing information about a path expression, including index range in the get group vector, error codes, and error messages.

classes.name: Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult
classes.description: Protocol Buffer message representing the result of a requested path in a Get response.

classes.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult
classes.description: Protocol Buffer message representing a resolved object path and its parameters in a Get response.

classes.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult__ResultParamsEntry
classes.description: Protocol Buffer message representing a single parameter entry within a resolved path result.

methods.name: void MSG_HANDLER_HandleGet(Usp__Msg * usp,char * controller_endpoint,mtp_conn_t * mtpc)
methods.description: Main handler for incoming USP Get messages. Validates request, allocates data structures, processes each path expression, and constructs a response.

methods.name: void ExpandGetPathExpression(int get_expr_index,char * path_expr,int depth,get_expr_info_t * gi,group_get_vector_t * ggv)
methods.description: Resolves a path expression into parameters and group get vector entries, handling errors if path resolution fails.

methods.name: void FormPathExprResponse(int get_expr_index,char * path_expr,get_expr_info_t * gi,group_get_vector_t * ggv,kv_vector_t * kvv,Usp__Msg * resp)
methods.description: Forms the response for a specific path expression, including successfully retrieved parameters and error details.

methods.name: void AddResolvedPathResult(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * path,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a parameter result to the response, creating object path hierarchy entries as needed.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * FindResolvedPath(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * obj_path)
methods.description: Searches backwards through the response to find an existing resolved path object matching a given object path.

methods.name: Usp__Msg * CreateGetResp(char * msg_id)
methods.description: Creates a new empty GetResponse message with a specified message ID.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * AddGetResp_ReqPathRes(Usp__Msg * resp,char * requested_path,int err_code,char * err_msg)
methods.description: Adds a requested path result to the response, initializing error codes and messages.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * AddReqPathRes_ResolvedPathResult(Usp__GetResp__RequestedPathResult * req_path_result,char * obj_path)
methods.description: Adds a resolved object path entry to a requested path result.

methods.name: Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult__ResultParamsEntry * AddResolvedPathRes_ParamsEntry(Usp__GetResp__ResolvedPathResult * resolved_path_res,char * param_name,char * value)
methods.description: Adds a parameter key-value pair to a resolved path result.

methods.name: void HandleDirectGet(int num_path_expr,char ** path_exprs,int depth,get_expr_info_t * get_expr_info,group_get_vector_t * ggv,Usp__Msg * resp)
methods.description: Handles optimized direct get requests via the USP broker, resolving parameters and handling unresolved parameters separately.
